# SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB — the facts — answer key

1. Statement → systemNhận định → hệ
   - r1.h: PostgreSQL
   - r2.h: MongoDB
   - r3.h: SQL Server
   - r4.h: MySQL
   - r5.h: MySQL
   - r6.h: MongoDB
   Three are relational (tables, each fact once, JOIN); MongoDB is a document store (an order and its lines in one document). Licences differ more than features: PostgreSQL and MySQL are free at any size, SQL Server only while small or in development.VI: Ba hệ là quan hệ (bảng, mỗi sự thật một lần, JOIN); MongoDB là kho document (một đơn và các dòng của nó trong một document). Giấy phép khác nhau nhiều hơn tính năng: PostgreSQL và MySQL miễn phí ở mọi cỡ, SQL Server chỉ khi nhỏ hoặc đang phát triển.

exercises.title: One order, two shapes: rows and a document
exercises.problemHtml:
Build order 1 of CT Shop as the document MongoDB would store: one row, one column doc = {"_id", "customer": {"id", "name", "city"}, "status", "items": [{"sku", "name", "qty", "unit_price"} … ordered by sku]}, from the tables.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • jsonb_build_object for objects, a correlated jsonb_agg(… ORDER BY p.sku) for the items array.
  • Key names exactly as above.

-- ctshop.sql: sample schema + data of this task (READ ONLY — the grader loads it by itself; editing this tab changes nothing).
-- ctshop.sql: lược đồ + dữ liệu mẫu của bài (CHỈ ĐỂ ĐỌC — máy chấm tự nạp; sửa tab này không ảnh hưởng gì).
-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

exercises.title: Shapes, myths and the right question
exercises.problemHtml:
Lesson 17.1 in three questions.

This set has 3 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. Work each one out yourself first (on paper or in psql on your own PostgreSQL), then check — every explanation after Submit says why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanation of every question appears after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Bài 17.1 trong ba câu.

Bộ này có 3 câu. Không có gì để chạy: trả lời trong khung bên phải rồi bấm Nộp. Hãy tự giải trước (ra giấy hoặc chạy trong psql trên PostgreSQL của bạn) rồi mới kiểm — giải thích sau khi Nộp nói rõ vì sao phương án "trông đúng" lại sai.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Shapes, myths and the right question — answer key

1. Which question should come before "which database is best?"Câu hỏi nào nên đặt trước "CSDL nào tốt nhất?"
   Answer: b) linked facts or self-contained documents — and who will run it?
   Brands have no ranking; shapes, correctness needs and operations do decide.VI: Thương hiệu không có thứ hạng; hình dạng dữ liệu, nhu cầu đúng đắn và vận hành mới quyết định.

2. "NoSQL means no design." What is true?"NoSQL nghĩa là không cần thiết kế." Điều gì đúng?
   Answer: a) the schema moves into your code — choosing what to embed is design
   You still decide shapes, indexes and what is copied where.VI: Bạn vẫn phải quyết định hình dạng, chỉ mục và chép cái gì vào đâu.

3. Which statement about MySQL is true today?Nhận định nào về MySQL đúng hiện nay?
   Answer: c) it has a binary JSON type (since 5.7)
   JSON since 5.7 (2015); InnoDB is transactional and the default engine.VI: JSON từ 5.7 (2015); InnoDB có giao dịch và là engine mặc định.
